mapper.select: SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM requirement GROUP BY status
SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM task GROUP BY status
SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM bug GROUP BY status
SELECT severity, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM bug GROUP BY severity

SELECT p.id AS projectId, p.name AS projectName, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM requirement r WHERE r.project_id = p.id) AS reqCnt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM task t WHERE t.project_id = p.id) AS taskCnt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bug b WHERE b.project_id = p.id) AS bugCnt FROM project p ORDER BY p.id

SELECT s.id AS sprintId, s.name AS sprintName, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM task t WHERE t.sprint_id = s.id) AS taskCnt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bug b WHERE b.sprint_id = s.id) AS bugCnt FROM sprint s ORDER BY s.id DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(assignee, ''), '未指派') AS assignee, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM task GROUP BY assignee ORDER BY cnt DESC
SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(assignee, ''), '未指派') AS assignee, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM bug GROUP BY assignee ORDER BY cnt DESC
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d') AS day, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM requirement WHERE created_at >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 29 DAY) GROUP BY day ORDER BY day
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d') AS day, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM bug WHERE created_at >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 29 DAY) GROUP BY day ORDER BY day

SELECT p.id AS projectId, p.name AS projectName, COUNT(r.id) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN r.status IN ('done', 'approved') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS doneCnt FROM project p LEFT JOIN requirement r ON r.project_id = p.id GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY p.id
